Class TCPRemoteCommitProvider

java.lang.Object
org.apache.openjpa.event.AbstractRemoteCommitProvider
org.apache.openjpa.event.TCPRemoteCommitProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
RemoteCommitProvider, Configurable, Closeable
Direct Known Subclasses:
DynamicTCPRemoteCommitProvider
public class TCPRemoteCommitProvider extends AbstractRemoteCommitProvider
TCP-based implementation of RemoteCommitProvider that listens for object modifications and propagates those changes to other RemoteCommitProviders over TCP sockets.
Since:
0.2.5.0
Author:
Brian Leair, Patrick Linskey

    • setAddresses

      public void setAddresses(String names) throws UnknownHostException
      Sets the list of addresses of peers to which this provider will send events to. The peers are semicolon-separated names list in the form of "myhost1:portA;myhost2:portB".
      Parameters:
      names - the list of addresses of peers to which this provider will send events to
      Throws:
      UnknownHostException - in case peer name cannot be resolved

    • addressesChanged

      protected void addressesChanged()
      Updates the addresses from which incoming connections are accepted. Must be invoked, while holding _addressesLock, whenever _addresses has been changed.

    • acceptsConnectionFrom

      protected boolean acceptsConnectionFrom(InetAddress address)
      Whether this provider accepts an incoming connection from the given address. Connections from this host are always accepted; connections from other hosts only if they are one of the configured peers, unless RestrictToPeers is turned off. The port of the peers is not considered, as the peers connect from arbitrary local ports.
      Parameters:
      address - the address of the remote end of the incoming connection
      Returns:
      true if the connection is accepted

    • refreshesAddressesOnDemand

      protected boolean refreshesAddressesOnDemand()
      Whether this provider can refresh its addresses when a connection from an unknown host arrives, see refreshAddresses(long). Defaults to false.
      Returns:
      true if refreshAddresses(long) may find further peers

    • refreshAddresses

      protected void refreshAddresses(long acceptedNanos)
      Refreshes the addresses of the peers before a connection from an unknown host is rejected. It is invoked on the thread receiving that connection, not on the thread accepting connections, and only if refreshesAddressesOnDemand() returns true.
      Parameters:
      acceptedNanos - the System.nanoTime() at which the connection was accepted; a refresh started later already covers this connection
